lead.description: the average of absolute forecast errors after each error is expressed as a percentage of the observed value

self_checks.title: Three forecasts
self_checks.prompt: Observations 100, 200 and 50 are forecast as 110, 160 and 80. What is the mean absolute percentage error?
self_checks.answer: The mean absolute percentage error is 30.

self_checks.title: Two forecasts
self_checks.prompt: Observations 80 and 120 are forecast as 100 and 90. What is the mean absolute percentage error?
self_checks.answer: Each absolute percentage error is 25, so the mean is 25.

self_checks.title: A zero observation
self_checks.prompt: One observation in the scoring period is 0. What happens to the mean absolute percentage error?
self_checks.answer: It is undefined, because the percentage error divides by the observation.

hyndman_koehler2006.title: Another look at measures of forecast accuracy

overview_sentence: The [mean absolute percentage error](articles/mean-absolute-percentage-error.qmd) averages absolute forecast errors as percentages of the observations.
